title: न्यायाधीशमाथि महाभियोगका विषयमा कानूनमन्त्रीसहित ५ रास्वपा सांसदसँग रविको परामर्श
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । सर्वोच्च अदालतका केही न्यायाधीशमाथि महाभियोग दर्ता गर्ने व्यापक चर्चाका बीच सत्तारुढ राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीका सभापति रवि लामिछानेले सोमबार सघन छलफल चलाएका छन् । उक्त पार्टीबाट प्रतिनिधिसभामा प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने पाँच कानुनी व्यवसायीसमेत रहेका सांसदसँग उनले छलफल गरेका हुन् । कानुन मन्त्री सोभिता गौतम, मधु चौलागाईं, समीक्षा बाँस्कोटा, सुलभ खरेल र गजाला शमीम मिकरानी छलफलमा सहभागी थिए । सभापति लामिछानेले महाभियोग दर्ताका प्रक्रिया र महाभियोग लगाउने आधारहरुको विषयमा जिज्ञासा राखेका थिए । छलफलमा सहभागी अधिवक्ता तथा सांसद मधु चौलागाईंलाई नेपाल प्रेसले सम्पर्क गर्दा तत्कालै महाभियोग लैजाने कुरा नभएको बताए । आचार्यका अनुसार सभापति लामिछानेले पनि न्यायालयलाई घाइते बनाएरमात्रै छोड्ने कुरा नहुने धारणा राखेका थिए । यदि अहिले चर्चा भएका न्यायाधीशमाथि महाभियोग लगाउने हो भने त्यसका आधार र कारणको किटान गरिनुपर्ने र महाभियोग दर्ता गरिसकेपछि फिर्ता हुनेजस्ता काम हुन नहुने लामिछानेको चासो रहेको छलफलमा सहभागी अर्का एक सांसदले बताए । उनका अनुसार हालसम्म महाभियोग सिफारिस समिति गठन गर्ने निर्णय भएको, तर गठन नभएको अवस्थामा महाभियोग दर्ता गर्ने कुरै नहुने लामिछानेको धारणा थियो । जुडिसियरी गिजोल्ने कुरा हुँदैन – मधु चौलागाईँ सांसद मधु चौलागाईँले महाभियोग लगाउने र पारित गर्ने आधार सुनिश्चित नगरी कुनै काम पनि अगाडि नबढ्ने बताए । उनले भने- हामीसँग अहिले संसदमा १८२ सीट छ । सभामुखले केही गर्न पाउनुहुन्न, प्रधानमन्त्रीज्यूलाई ल्याउने कुरा हुँदैन । महाभियोग पारित गर्न हामीसँग पाँचजना पुग्दैन । त्यो पाँच जना कहाँबाट ल्याउने ? पहिलो कुरा लाउने आधार चाहियो, दोस्रो कुरा लगाएपछि सम्पन्न गर्छौँ भन्ने आधार पनि चाहियो । हामीले त्यही सल्लाह दिएका छौँ– पहिला आधार तयार पारौँ । नत्र, जुडिसियरी गिजोल्ने कुरा हुँदैन भनेका छौँ । चयनमुखी महाभियोग हुँदैन- यज्ञमणि न्यौपाने रास्वपाकै अर्का सांसद तथा अधिवक्ता यज्ञमणि न्यौपानेले चयनमुखी महाभियोगको पक्षमा आफू नभएको र पार्टी सभापति लामिछानेको रुची पनि त्यस्तो नरहेको बताएका छन् । यद्यपि, उनी सोमबारको छलफलमा सहभागी थिएनन् । उनले भने- न्यायाधीशलाई महाभियोग लगाउनेजस्तो कुरा त्यसै ख्यालख्याल गरेजस्तो हुँदैन । त्यसमाथि निश्चित न्यायाधीशलाई निश्चित कारण देखाएर महाभियोग लगाउने, कसैलाई नलगाउने भन्नेजस्ता चयनमुखी अभ्यास त झन् हुनै सक्दैन । पहिला अध्ययन गरेर, आधार, औचित्य विविध सम्भावनामाथि छलफल गरेरमात्रै अगाडि बढ्ने कुरा हुन्छ । न्यायाधीशजस्ता सम्मानित र प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्तिका बारेमा बजारु हल्ला गर्दै, ‘अहिल्यै–तुरुन्तै’ भनेर चलिरहेका अफवाह जायज छैनन् । बेकारका हुन् । समग्र न्यायालयको सुधारका कुरा छन् । त्यो आवश्यक पनि छ । त्यसो गर्नका लागि हामी प्रतिवद्ध पनि छौँ । कहाँ–कहाँ, के–के गर्नुपर्छ भन्ने विषय कानुन र विधिका आधारमा हुन्छ । हल्ला र लहडमा, चयनमुखी शैलीमा हुँदैन । Kathmandu. Amid widespread talk of impeachment against some Supreme Court judges, ruling National Independent Party President Rabi Lamichhane held intensive discussions on Monday with five lawmakers representing the party in the House of Representatives, including legal professionals. Law Minister Sobhita Gautam, Madhu Chaulagain, Samiksha Baskota, Sulabh Kharel and Gazala Shamim Mikrani participated in the discussion. Speaker Lamichhane raised questions about the process of registering an impeachment and the grounds for impeachment. When contacted by Nepal Press, advocate and MP Madhu Chaulagain, who participated in the discussion, said that there was no immediate impeachment motion. According to Acharya, President Lamichhane also expressed the view that there was no question of leaving the judiciary alone after injuring it. Another MP who participated in the discussion said that Lamichhane was concerned that if the currently discussed judge is to be impeached, the basis and reasons for it should be specified and that there should be no withdrawal after the impeachment is filed. According to him, Lamichhane was of the opinion that a decision has been made to form an impeachment recommendation committee so far, but there should be no question of filing an impeachment if it has not been formed. There is no point in slandering the judiciary - Madhu Chaulagain MP Madhu Chaulagain said that no work will proceed without ensuring the basis for impeachment and its passage. He said - We currently have 182 seats in the parliament. The Speaker cannot do anything, there is no question of bringing the Prime Minister. We do not have enough five to pass the impeachment. Where will we get those five? First, we need a basis to bring the matter, second, we also need a basis that we will complete it after bringing the matter. We have given the same advice - let's first prepare the basis. Otherwise, we have said that there will be no question of wooing the judiciary. There is no selective impeachment - Yagyamani Neupane Another RSP MP and advocate, Yagyamani Neupane, has said that he is not in favor of selective impeachment and that party President Lamichhane is not interested in it either. However, he was not present at Monday's discussion. He said , "Imposing a judge's impeachment is not something that can be done lightly. Moreover, there can be no selective practice of impeaching a certain judge for a specific reason and not impeaching anyone. It is a matter of moving forward only after first studying, discussing the basis, justification and various possibilities." The rumors circulating about respected and distinguished people like judges, saying 'immediately', are not justified. They are useless. There is a need for reform of the entire judiciary. That is necessary. We are committed to doing that. Where and what should be done is based on law and procedure. It is not done in a rumor-driven, selective manner.

Amid widespread talk of impeachment against some Supreme Court judges, ruling National Independent Party President Rabi Lamichhane held intensive discussions on Monday with five lawmakers representing the party in the House of Representatives, including legal professionals. Law Minister Sobhita Gautam, Madhu Chaulagain, Samiksha Baskota, Sulabh Kharel and Gazala Shamim Mikrani participated in the discussion. Speaker Lamichhane raised questions about the process of registering an impeachment and the grounds for impeachment. When contacted by Nepal Press, advocate and MP Madhu Chaulagain, who participated in the discussion, said that there was no immediate impeachment motion. According to Acharya, President Lamichhane also expressed the view that there was no question of leaving the judiciary alone after injuring it. Another MP who participated in the discussion said that Lamichhane was concerned that if the currently discussed judge is to be impeached, the basis and reasons for it should be specified and that there should be no withdrawal after the impeachment is filed. According to him, Lamichhane was of the opinion that a decision has been made to form an impeachment recommendation committee so far, but there should be no question of filing an impeachment if it has not been formed. There is no point in slandering the judiciary - Madhu Chaulagain MP Madhu Chaulagain said that no work will proceed without ensuring the basis for impeachment and its passage. He said - We currently have 182 seats in the parliament. The Speaker cannot do anything, there is no question of bringing the Prime Minister. We do not have enough five to pass the impeachment. We have given the same advice - let's first prepare the basis. Otherwise, we have said that there will be no question of wooing the judiciary. There is no selective impeachment - Yagyamani Neupane Another RSP MP and advocate, Yagyamani Neupane, has said that he is not in favor of selective impeachment and that party President Lamichhane is not interested in it either. However, he was not present at Monday's discussion. He said , "Imposing a judge's impeachment is not something that can be done lightly. Moreover, there can be no selective practice of impeaching a certain judge for a specific reason and not impeaching anyone. It is a matter of moving forward only after first studying, discussing the basis, justification and various possibilities." The rumors circulating about respected and distinguished people like judges, saying 'immediately', are not justified. They are useless. There is a need for reform of the entire judiciary. That is necessary. We are committed to doing that. Where and what should be done is based on law and procedure. It is not done in a rumor-driven, selective manner.

रास्वपाकै अर्का सांसद तथा अधिवक्ता यज्ञमणि न्यौपानेले चयनमुखी महाभियोगको पक्षमा आफू नभएको र पार्टी सभापति लामिछानेको रुची पनि त्यस्तो नरहेको बताएका छन् । यद्यपि, उनी सोमबारको छलफलमा सहभागी थिएनन् ।

उनले भने- न्यायाधीशलाई महाभियोग लगाउनेजस्तो कुरा त्यसै ख्यालख्याल गरेजस्तो हुँदैन । त्यसमाथि निश्चित न्यायाधीशलाई निश्चित कारण देखाएर महाभियोग लगाउने, कसैलाई नलगाउने भन्नेजस्ता चयनमुखी अभ्यास त झन् हुनै सक्दैन । पहिला अध्ययन गरेर, आधार, औचित्य विविध सम्भावनामाथि छलफल गरेरमात्रै अगाडि बढ्ने कुरा हुन्छ ।

न्यायाधीशजस्ता सम्मानित र प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्तिका बारेमा बजारु हल्ला गर्दै, ‘अहिल्यै–तुरुन्तै’ भनेर चलिरहेका अफवाह जायज छैनन् । बेकारका हुन् । समग्र न्यायालयको सुधारका कुरा छन् । त्यो आवश्यक पनि छ । त्यसो गर्नका लागि हामी प्रतिवद्ध पनि छौँ । कहाँ–कहाँ, के–के गर्नुपर्छ भन्ने विषय कानुन र विधिका आधारमा हुन्छ । हल्ला र लहडमा, चयनमुखी शैलीमा हुँदैन ।

Kathmandu. Amid widespread talk of impeachment against some Supreme Court judges, ruling National Independent Party President Rabi Lamichhane held intensive discussions on Monday with five lawmakers representing the party in the House of Representatives, including legal professionals. Law Minister Sobhita Gautam, Madhu Chaulagain, Samiksha Baskota, Sulabh Kharel and Gazala Shamim Mikrani participated in the discussion. Speaker Lamichhane raised questions about the process of registering an impeachment and the grounds for impeachment. When contacted by Nepal Press, advocate and MP Madhu Chaulagain, who participated in the discussion, said that there was no immediate impeachment motion. According to Acharya, President Lamichhane also expressed the view that there was no question of leaving the judiciary alone after injuring it. Another MP who participated in the discussion said that Lamichhane was concerned that if the currently discussed judge is to be impeached, the basis and reasons for it should be specified and that there should be no withdrawal after the impeachment is filed. According to him, Lamichhane was of the opinion that a decision has been made to form an impeachment recommendation committee so far, but there should be no question of filing an impeachment if it has not been formed. There is no point in slandering the judiciary - Madhu Chaulagain MP Madhu Chaulagain said that no work will proceed without ensuring the basis for impeachment and its passage. He said - We currently have 182 seats in the parliament. The Speaker cannot do anything, there is no question of bringing the Prime Minister. We do not have enough five to pass the impeachment. Where will we get those five? First, we need a basis to bring the matter, second, we also need a basis that we will complete it after bringing the matter. We have given the same advice - let's first prepare the basis. Otherwise, we have said that there will be no question of wooing the judiciary. There is no selective impeachment - Yagyamani Neupane Another RSP MP and advocate, Yagyamani Neupane, has said that he is not in favor of selective impeachment and that party President Lamichhane is not interested in it either. However, he was not present at Monday's discussion. He said , "Imposing a judge's impeachment is not something that can be done lightly. Moreover, there can be no selective practice of impeaching a certain judge for a specific reason and not impeaching anyone. It is a matter of moving forward only after first studying, discussing the basis, justification and various possibilities." The rumors circulating about respected and distinguished people like judges, saying 'immediately', are not justified. They are useless. There is a need for reform of the entire judiciary. That is necessary. We are committed to doing that. Where and what should be done is based on law and procedure. It is not done in a rumor-driven, selective manner.
